actual_scope: Lean-prove the exact scalar-shadow row recurrence for appending any one of LemmaG.Event.relabel, add, scale, copy, or clear to an arbitrary finite event prefix, over every semiring and without a finite-register assumption.

bottleneck_link: HyperplaneEnd.hpe_word takes the helper scalar-shadow unit row as hS. A kernel-proved update law exposes the exact recurrence a future source-bound event translation can fold to establish hS.
stop_rule: Stop after the universal five-constructor recurrence and axiom-checked Lean build pass. Do not expand this package into an emitted-word binding or selected-supplier claim.

Registered package metadata and base-source pins pass check-only.
